mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in labor employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which is associated with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS change is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 4.5% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS monthly change > 0.1%, or the Rank IC for this joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% and the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 2.0% annualized, it indicates a late-cycle recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% AND GDPC1 < 2.0% (annualized), or the Rank IC for this regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which is associated with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO shows a positive month-over-month change, or the Rank IC for INDPRO change is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 90 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 and housing starts (HOUST) below 500 signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95 AND HOUST < 500, or the Rank IC for this joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized) AND UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for this regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
